description:
[read-only] The brand's scheduled auto-judge: its settings (off by default) and recent proposal groups, one per run. Each post gets one call (boost, ad or let go) with budget, window, season end, reason, the stored prediction and whether it is over the owner's caps or the agent limits. A missed-window post is only ever let go. Read-only: approving, rejecting and changing the settings stay with the owner or an admin in the app; nothing is activated or charged.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/auto-judge.)

brandId.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. Omitted: the key's brand (a brand-bound key) or the owner's active brand (required once the account is in more than one organization).

limit.description: How many recent groups to return (clamped).

name: ads_auto_judge
title: Auto-judge proposals
